title: GPUStack SAML callback accepts forged identities even when SAML is not configured
summary: The callback issues sessions without validating SAML assertions. A network caller can impersonate an existing administrator or create a non-admin account; captured signed assertions can also be replayed.

severity.rationale: Unauthenticated network callers can take over administrator accounts and gain control of managed infrastructure. Account and sensitive-data exposure warrant action within 72 hours; no exploitation status is inferred.

exposure: Network access to /auth/saml/callback is sufficient. Disabling or leaving SAML unconfigured does not prevent the vulnerable callback from issuing sessions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade gpustack to 2.2.2 or later. Until then, block network access to /auth/saml/callback; disabling SAML configuration alone is ineffective.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating and restarting can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed version and the component used by running processes meet the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
